reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：接入网关 → 任务与 outbox 派发 → 缓存接入 → 搜索接入 → CDN 与回源 → 通知通道接入 → 可观测性与审计 → 部署、备份与容量。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: API Gateway → Jobs and Outbox Dispatcher → Cache Adapter → Search Adapter → CDN and Origin → Notification Channels → Observability and Audit → Deployment, Backup and Capacity. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
